summary: Refactored goal validation to use Zod schemas: GoalWorkerOutput is now inferred from GoalWorkerOutputSchema in backend-types.ts, validateWorkerOutput in cli-worker.ts now uses GoalWorkerOutputSchema.safeParse(), and validatePlan in planner.ts now uses PlanInputSchema.safeParse() with post-parse workingDir expansion, dependency-cycle detection, and PlanStep default field assembly preserved. Added compatibility handling so planner keeps existing error semantics and still ignores non-boolean buildGate.postExecutionReview values. Verification passed: pnpm vitest run src/goal/planner.test.ts src/goal/cli-worker.test.ts and pnpm build.
